hero.badge: Indonesia's First Specialty Coffee Producer & Exporter
hero.subtitle: From the highlands of Sumatera Lintong to tables around the world — Kopi Siholta brings the authentic flavor of Humbang Hasundutan, North Sumatra, to your cup.

heritage.title: Passed Down Through Generations
heritage.subtitle: PT Siholta Toba Indonesia was born in Humbang Hasundutan — a region the world has recognized since the colonial era as producing the most prestigious specialty coffee in the archipelago.
heritage.card1_desc: Over 200 partner farmer families across the Lintong and Dolok highlands, cultivating traditional coffee trees for generations.
heritage.card2_desc: Post-harvest processing follows specialty coffee standards — from washing, honey, to natural process with sun drying.
heritage.card3_desc: Our products are certified by international verification bodies and meet export standards to America, Europe, and East Asia.
heritage.card4_desc: Every cup of Kopi Siholta is an expression of Batak Toba pride — a heritage preserved and passed to future generations.

pioneer.title: First & Foremost
pioneer.subtitle: Carving history as Indonesia's specialty coffee pioneer.

vision.title: Making Indonesia the King of World Coffee
vision.subtitle: By 2035, we target a 5× increase in exports, expanding our farmer partner network to 1,000+ families, and Kopi Siholta present in 30 countries.

agriculture.label: Agriculture
agriculture.desc: Cultivation and processing of specialty coffee from the North Sumatra highlands with international standards.

tourism.label: Tourism
tourism.desc: Agro-tourism experience at our farmshop locations — directly experiencing the journey from bean to cup.

export.label: Economy
export.desc: Driving a coffee-based creative economy that empowers local communities and reaches global markets.

products.title: Taste Authentic Kopi Siholta
products.subtitle: Every variant is processed with the highest dedication, hand-selected from our partner farmers' farms in Sumatera Lintong.

export.title: From Sumatera to the World
export.subtitle: Kopi Siholta has been trusted by importers and distributors across the globe. Our commitment: consistent quality and transparent supply chain.

b2b.title: Be Part of Our Story
b2b.subtitle: Kopi Siholta is open to partnerships with importers, distributors, cafes, hotels, and global coffee brands that share our values.
b2b.type1_desc: Join our distribution network to bring Kopi Siholta to your local market.
b2b.type2_desc: Cafes, hotels, restaurants — supplied with fresh beans that support your brand story.
b2b.type3_desc: Private label production partnership for coffee brands looking to launch specialty products.
b2b.type4_desc: Custom-made hampers and gift sets for corporate needs — premium coffee as a symbol of appreciation.

omni.title: Buy Kopi Siholta Now
omni.subtitle: Find our products on your favorite marketplace platforms.

contact.title: Let's Connect
contact.subtitle: Have questions about our products, business opportunities, or just want to say hello? Our team is ready to help.
contact.wa_desc: Faster response for product and business inquiries.

footer.tagline: From Sumatera Lintong to the World — Kopi Siholta, Indonesia's Specialty Coffee Pioneer.
